milestones.title: Finding the street
milestones.description: Station exits, street levels and building footprints established the first walk from A2.

milestones.title: Reading the shopfronts
milestones.description: Dated photographs informed signs, windows and shutters along the station approach.

milestones.title: Into the restaurant lane
milestones.description: The 159 m walk to the Yasuda junction gained recessed entrances and a side trip past Ajishino and Chōryū.

milestones.title: Across the bridge
milestones.description: The walk reached LIFE. The game measures 805 m from A2 to the supermarket forecourt within 1.34 km of connected streets.

milestones.title: Street activity
milestones.description: Pedestrians, bicycles and deliveries began moving through the modeled streets, with separate sounds for shops and traffic.

milestones.title: Returning to a place
milestones.description: Players can revisit familiar places and save their own walks in the private Windows build.
